review_scope.population: all Strict-noncorrect DeepSeek selective-retrieval cases in the frozen Main-60 case index

review_passes.name: answer_blind_evidence_content_and_packaging
review_passes.inputs: question, reference, frozen final EvidenceBundle, provenance, canonical source, and observed/selected/final retrieval transitions
review_passes.description: Evidence sufficiency and packaging causality were revalidated without candidate or judge outcome. All 106 content_state labels remained unchanged.

review_passes.name: answerer_utilisation
review_passes.description: Candidate and judge information were consulted only after Pass 1 labels were frozen.

packaging_causality_contract.demonstrated_relevant_loss: Requires direct trace evidence that answer-bearing content was observed or selected and then omitted before the final EvidenceBundle.
packaging_causality_contract.possible_noise_or_ordering_contribution: Sufficient answer-bearing content remains, while bundle order or noise may plausibly affect use without direct loss.
packaging_causality_contract.no_demonstrated_packaging_failure: No answer-bearing acquisition-to-bundle loss is shown. Missing final content alone is insufficient.
packaging_causality_contract.indeterminate: Available provenance cannot support a stable acquisition-to-bundle decision.
packaging_causality_contract.retrieval_non_acquisition_rule: Required content not observed by the retriever is retrieval non-acquisition, not packaging loss.
packaging_causality_contract.partial_acquisition_rule: A partial observed/selected/final trace demonstrates packaging loss only when the answer-bearing portion is directly shown to disappear downstream.

revision_history.revision_reason: Harmonise packaging causality with the Qwen review and enforce a true answer-blind Pass 1.

review_guards: Pass 1 used question, reference, frozen EvidenceBundle, provenance, canonical source, and retrieval transitions; candidate answer and judge outcome were excluded.
Pass 1 content and packaging labels were frozen before Pass 2.
Pass 2 used candidate answer and judge information only when content_state was complete_and_focused or complete_but_noisy.
Locator Any-hit and All-hit are diagnostic coverage signals, not semantic sufficiency labels.
Gold annotations are non-exhaustive; complete alternative answer-bearing support may establish sufficiency despite locator no-hit.
Direct source/reference contradiction is distinguished from mere under-support of an overprecise reference.
Required content not observed is retrieval non-acquisition and cannot be labelled demonstrated packaging loss.
Demonstrated packaging loss requires direct observed/selected-to-final loss of answer-bearing content.
No question, reference, candidate-answer, or evidence text is copied into this review artifact.
